sealed.statement: For a runtime service carrying fresh non-empty data-affinity weights, the suboptimality observer and the placement intent share one decision: whenever isDataAffinityPlacementSuboptimal reports true, the same evaluation evidence yields a minted REPLACE toward an affinity-preferred feasible node through the existing full-score placement intent — or the observer does not report true — so detection can never latch without a cure. Modeled on the exact 2026-07-21T15:06:54 live ordering (svc-movielens-topn healthy 2 of desired 2 across 5 nodes, observer fired once on the affinity term, rebalance() ran and minted zero moves, weightedLocality stayed 0.000 for 300s with attributionRows=2 and working top-10), proven by a deterministic discriminator at the observer-intent seam that is red on current HEAD, with no new scoring formula (only the existing kernel terms and margins), no churn below the incumbent-retention margin, no flag or disable switch, byte-identical behavior for entities without preferDataAffinity, and the unchanged five-node MovieLens live scenario converging weightedLocality above zero once planning is admitted.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Data affinity remains intrinsic policy: no feature flag, disable switch, or per-call option may be introduced, and no flag may survive the session. Entities without preferDataAffinity retain byte-identical behavior.

Reuse only the existing placement-kernel terms and margins (NODE_AFFINITY_WEIGHT, group weights, INCUMBENT_MOVEMENT_COST retention margin). The fix aligns the observer and the intent on the same inequality and candidate universe; it must not introduce a second scorer, new weights, or new constants beyond naming existing scalars.

No REPLACE may be planned when the affinity gradient does not exceed the existing incumbent-retention movement margin. The parity fix must not increase move churn for states the full-score intent already ranks as keep-incumbent correctly.

The MovePlanner placement kernel remains the single owner of the move decision. The observer must not mint moves, mutate state, or re-derive placement outside the kernel; parity is achieved by sharing the kernel's own decision surface, not by duplicating it.

Before source change acceptance, a deterministic discriminator at the real observer-intent seam must reproduce the 2026-07-21T15:06:54 detect-without-cure state (fresh non-empty affinity weights favoring data nodes, incumbents holding none of the accessed data, observer true, zero minted moves), stay red on current HEAD, be red-on-revert for any fix, and include negative controls proving no move is minted below the retention margin and no behavior change for entities without preferDataAffinity.

claim: Run-1 mechanism trace (immutable archive data/examples/service-data-affinity-demo-archive/run-2026-07-21T15-14-00-080Z.tar.gz, report movielens-lagrange-service-affinity-live-2026-07-21T15-10-38-912Z): the affinity detection chain is landed and FIRED — at 15:06:54.973 node-0 logged Suboptimal-rebalancing-state for svc-movielens-topn with healthy 2 of desired 2 across 5 nodes, which with count and spread satisfied can only be isDataAffinityPlacementSuboptimal (src/rebalancer/move-planner-state-methods.js:715-720 -> placement-owner-decision.js:478), proving nodeWeights were non-empty and a data-node challenger beat the off-data incumbents — yet rebalance() minted zero moves and weightedLocality stayed 0.000 (placementScore=0: both replicas hold none of the accessed data; metric computed by the production buildServiceDataAffinityWeights via examples/service-data-affinity/affinity-demo-evidence.js:47-74). Root asymmetry: the observer compares affinity-only over unfiltered readyNodes (placement-owner-decision.js:504) while the intent minter selects from capacity-filtered feasibleNodes under the full multi-dimensional score plus reservations (move-planner.js:305-308,650-680; placement-owner-decision.js:365-411), then pressure gating — so detection does not imply a cure. The one-line-only logging is a dedup blind to locality (rebalancer-evaluation-methods.js:116-126,169-184 signal excludes affinity), and the whole affinity decision path emits zero diagnostics. Secondary environmental starvation, out of this seal: the WAIT_CONTROL_PLANE_PRIORITY_STABILITY planning gate deferred non-system planning 160 times in the run (rebalancer-priority-recovery-planning-gate-methods.js:108-144) under 306 CL-017 CDC divergence hits, leaving only ~2 open planning windows before leadership loss at 15:10:23.

Ledger prior-art: locality convergence requires policy assembly (getRuntimeServicePolicy, quest runtime-service-affinity-policy-lift, commit 4c0101b9), the full-score MovePlanner kernel with DATA_AFFINITY 16w vs INCUMBENT_MOVEMENT_COST 4 (quest placement-data-affinity-tier1b, 3ebff067), and the suboptimality observer re-planning trigger (quest runtime-service-affinity-suboptimality-observer, 1988437b) — the stack that produced three consecutive passes on 2026-07-20T15:41. Prior stalls: attributionRows=0 was the pk-projection authoritative-read drop, fixed 07-18; the 07-20 0.5-stall was the missing affinity term in isSuboptimalState plus the creating-owner wake seam, both fixed. The observer quest RECORDED an open bounded false-positive producing detect-without-cure (incumbent in the dominant-data latency group with zero node weight: trigger latches, scorer group term keeps incumbent, zero moves; candidate fix recorded: give the trigger the same AFFINITY_WEIGHT*groupWeight term so trigger and scorer share the full primary-score inequality — runtime-service-affinity-suboptimality-observer.md:27-28). Forbidden levers: no flag or disable switch (affinity is intrinsic, epic decision 2026-07-11), no new scoring formula, no churn below the retention margin, byte-identical for entities without preferDataAffinity, and reservation-based retainHealthyIncumbents hysteresis is REJECTED (symmetric-high freeze; the in-score retention margin is the chosen form).

hypothesis: Observer-intent parity fix: one policy fetch serves the whole periodic planning cycle — checkRebalance fetches the policy once and threads it through evaluateState(policy) and advanceCheckCadence(needsRebalance, evaluatedPolicy) into the existing rebalance(trigger, policy) parameter, so the cure judges the same affinity evidence the observer assessed and an evidence-losing re-fetch (diverged authoritative read dropping fresh service_partition_access weights) can no longer turn a detected affinity suboptimality into a silent zero-move round. No new scoring formula, no state, no flag; kernel and admission untouched. Discriminator test/rebalancer/unified-rebalancer-affinity-policy-refetch-parity.test.js models the 2026-07-21T15:06:54 detect-without-cure ordering through the real checkRebalance entrypoint: 7/7 green with fix, red on revert at the parity assertions, dt-prove red-on-revert-proven; rebalancer family 5828 pass with only the 6 pre-existing CL-043/044 failures; eslint clean; both duplication ratchets under baseline.

claim: Two secondary discoveries from discriminator construction, both outside this quest's seal but worth durable note: (1) the shared test/rebalancer/test-helpers.js DEFAULT storageAdmissionService stub returns {allowed:true,decisionType:'admitted'} while MovePlanner.filterNodesByCapacity requires result.decision===ADMISSION_DECISION.ALLOW ('allow'), so any test reaching the capacity filter through the default stub silently rejects EVERY candidate node (rejectionsByReason undefined) and produces degraded empty targets — createAllowAllStorageAdmissionService has the correct shape and should become the default or the stale stub fixed; (2) a triggered planning round under a policy WITHOUT preferDataAffinity is not inert in a topology where suitability ties break by node ordering: the kernel reshuffled a satisfied 2-replica placement toward lexically-earlier empty nodes (replace toward node-0) — in production this is masked because count/spread-satisfied states never trigger a round without the affinity observer, but it means any NEW trigger source added later could introduce churn; the incumbent-retention margin only guards the DATA_AFFINITY dimension, not plain suitability ties.

Independent verification passed exact attempt-1: fingerprint exact with no riders; contract preservation proven for every call site (evaluateState/advanceCheckCadence called only from checkRebalance, single rebalance call site, 18 no-arg test callers unaffected); constraints held (only the two named src files plus the discriminator, no kernel/admission/wake changes, no new formula or flag); staleness hazard adversarially probed and cleared (threading scoped to one periodic cycle, manual rebalance callers still fetch fresh); discriminator 7/7 with fix and red on exactly the two parity assertions at HEAD with restore green; family fail-set is exactly the 6 pre-existing CL-043/CL-044 failures (also failing on reverted src; they span the down-target and stale-phantom sibling files); eslint/file-size/duplication gates clean; every harness override shown to neutralize only unrelated mock-shape artifacts with the sealed seam running unmodified production code.
